questions.q: Omni-Man belongs to which alien race?
questions.why: Omni-Man is an alien Viltrumite from the planet Viltrum.
He was born Nolan and goes by Nolan Grayson on Earth.
Debbie is Omni-Man's first wife and the mother of Mark.

questions.q: In which issue of the comic does Omni-Man kill the Guardians of the Globe?
questions.why: In issue #7 he turns on the Guardians of the Globe and kills them.

questions.q: Which Grand Regent rules the Viltrum Empire over Omni-Man?
questions.why: Thragg rules the Viltrum Empire as Grand Regent, and he gravely wounds Nolan.

questions.q: Who voices Omni-Man in Amazon's Invincible?
questions.why: J.K. Simmons voices Nolan in the Invincible series and other media.

questions.q: Who is credited with writing Omni-Man alongside artist Cory Walker?
questions.why: Robert Kirkman wrote Invincible, and Cory Walker was the original artist.

questions.q: Roughly how old is Omni-Man, thanks to his alien longevity?
questions.why: Extreme longevity is one of his Viltrumite traits, and the character is said to be over two thousand years old.

questions.q: Which artist, later the main penciller, helped design Omni-Man's look?
questions.why: Ryan Ottley helped with Omni-Man's design and later became the comic's regular artist.

questions.q: Omni-Man debuted in Invincible #1 in which year?
questions.why: Omni-Man debuted in Invincible #1, cover-dated January 2003.
